about_page_description: Game audio designer. Music background, maths and physics nerd, hands-on with game engines and immersive training.
hook: I build game audio from both sides: creative and technical.
intro_sub: Belgium · DAE Howest · Technical sound design · XR Labs
background_1: Hi, I'm Igor. Games were the thing that pulled me in first, but after a while I wanted more than just playing them. I wanted to understand how games are built, why they work, and how all the different parts come together.
background_2: Before I got serious about game development, I was already deep into music. That is what naturally pushed me toward game audio, while maths and physics gave me the mindset to enjoy the technical side of implementation too.
background_3: At DAE in Kortrijk I studied C++, C#, Unity, Unreal, and middleware for three years. Working on actual projects made me want to stop just learning and start making things people can play.
approach_1: Right now I work at XR Labs as a lead technical sound designer. I make sounds, hook them up in-engine, and tweak them until they fit the scene.
approach_2: The best part is seeing people actually use what I build. I work on training sims for police, military, and customs, then watch real users test them and tell me what sounds wrong.
approach_3: That's why I spend so much time on Steam Audio: reflections, transmission, material absorption. In VR and AR, bad acoustics break immersion instantly.
cta_text: Working on a game or immersive project and need audio? Let's talk.
